periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary longitudinal axes of the eye patches are oriented at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering downwards and inwards toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an ovoid geometry with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward elongation, with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the horizontal midline of the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band at the visible lateral shoulder junction occupies approximately 30 percent of the vertical height of the visible torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, unbroken semi-circular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-brown chromatic saturation is present in the fur of the ventral and lower abdominal regions, contrasting with the high-value white fur of the cranium.
